description: Look up a film or TV show's director, cast, runtime, rating, and story.
author: MaiPai

examples: tell me about the movie Cobra

data_sources.when: each time the family asks about a film or TV show's director, cast, runtime, rating, or release date
data_sources.what: the title spoken in the request (e.g. 'Cobra'), and a release year when one was given

data_sources.destination: Wikipedia's own public REST summary API (en.wikipedia.org)
data_sources.when: each time a Wikidata match is found, to read its plain-language summary
data_sources.what: the film or TV show's own Wikipedia page title, resolved from Wikidata, never anything typed by the family

fallback_reply.text: Sorry, I'm having trouble looking that up right now.
fallback_reply.speech: Sorry, I'm having trouble looking that up right now.
